note: Data only. An entry names a package and the facts around it; it carries no command, script or URL to run. A licence is 'unverified' until an entry cites the licence file and the date it was read.

tools.name: Vitest coverage (V8 provider)
tools.purpose: Adds code coverage to a project that already uses Vitest.
tools.configurationChange: none required to install; enabling coverage is done with the --coverage flag or the coverage.enabled setting
tools.verify: Run the tests with the --coverage flag, then scan again: a coverage report should appear in the folder the configuration names.

licence.scope: the Vitest repository licence file; the licence the npm package itself declares was not separately checked

requirements: A project that already runs Vitest.
A JavaScript runtime built on V8, such as Node.js.
tools.maintenance: One more dev dependency to keep in step with the Vitest version.
limitations: Does not work on environments that are not built on V8, according to the Vitest documentation.
The catalog does not pin a version; the newest published version is installed when you confirm.

tools.name: jest-junit
tools.purpose: A Jest reporter that writes JUnit-compatible XML, which AUTOMATE (local) can read.
tools.configurationChange: add "jest-junit" to the reporters list in the Jest configuration; AUTOMATE (local) does not edit that file for you
tools.verify: Run Jest, then scan again: a junit.xml should appear in the working directory unless the reporter is configured otherwise.

licence.scope: the jest-junit repository licence file; the licence the npm package itself declares was not separately checked

requirements: A project that already runs Jest.
tools.maintenance: One more dev dependency, plus a reporters entry in the Jest configuration.
limitations: The catalog does not pin a version; the newest published version is installed when you confirm.

tools.name: pytest-cov
tools.purpose: A pytest plugin for measuring code coverage.
tools.configurationChange: none required to install; coverage is enabled with the plugin's options when pytest is run
tools.verify: Run pytest with the plugin's coverage option and a report format, then scan again: a coverage report should appear.

licence.scope: the pytest-cov repository licence file; the licence the PyPI package itself declares was not separately checked

requirements: A project that already runs pytest.
tools.maintenance: One more development dependency in the Python environment.
limitations: Installs into whichever Python environment the python command resolves to, which may not be the project's own.
The catalog does not pin a version; the newest published version is installed when you confirm.
